youtube_short.title: Your Portfolio Is Drifting — $46K Gone
youtube_short.description:
You set up auto-invest and forgot it — but your portfolio's been silently drifting for years. Without rebalancing, your 60/40 split can drift to 76/24, leaving you way more exposed than you planned. In a crash, that extra risk bites hard — and over 30 years on $200K, Vanguard says you're giving up $46,000. The fix? 15 minutes once a year. Set a reminder for January 1st. #personalfinance #investing #rebalancing #401k #wealthbuilding
